notes.title: Euclyca End of Torvid Update!
notes.content:
Euclyca <End of Torvid update>

This update was a planned one from the start, but only if the conditions of the real virus got better. It
dragged on so long, that I thought I was never going to release this update.  I don't know if it's actually over. But, to be quite honest. It's over to me. I can imagine it's over for a lot of people as well as they are probably sick of it.

Unfortunately we cannot ignore that it happened and around the time this game was being made. During development it was at the height of the pandemic. It sucks, it's unfortunate, but it happened.

Time doesn't move forward in the story standing still, so it's kind of hard to erase Torvid completely when it's a thing that is going on during that time period and no time has changed since then. So, it's gonna exist, but go away part-way through the journey now.

This means, some areas will re-open in the game and will now be able to be explored, but will take some play time to get to that point. Anyways, with this new update, here is what is new:

-Opened several areas that were previously locked due to Torvid-18. Some areas will remain closed no matter what due to the economic and financial damage caused by the virus and lock-downs.

-New Game+ is now available for those who beat the game after this update.

-One new secret boss can be found in Normellia.

-A new secret item is introduced into the game.
Can be found in one of the early areas of the game.

-Barfelenope is now playable for one fight during the story.

-Added in four new Anima Cards; Temi Card, Tain Card, The Ashes Card and Almadoren Card. Tain, The Ashes and Almadoren cards can only be obtained and used once during a New Game+. Meaning, you must beat the game in order to get them.

-For beating the game, you will get the Soren, Maria, Temi, Tain, The Ashes and Almadoren Anima Cards for a New Game+ save.

-The Tain Anima Card grants the entire party 10 levels instantly.

-The Temi Anima Card deals massive damage to all enemies in combat.

-The Almadoren Anima Card allows you to change all main party members into their Almadoren Outfits. *Cannot change back once used*.

-The Ashes Anima Card allows the other Ashe that you aren't using to join your party. Their summon is also able to come along as well, as long as you have unlocked them!

-Krosuji from Exiori will appear in Euclyca in Nino's house briefly. He was always around, but stayed between houses a lot or was out on missions. He will only appear after the Torvid announcement. He will be gone again after the Setsuno/Mathers stuff.

-Mina has a new class; Sōhei. This class utilizes her spear weapon and allows you to gain access to stronger spear weapons. Also has the ability to use black magic. Comes with the Holy Lance Limit Break.

-New spear weapons added into the game for Mina's class. Also an ultimate weapon too! The Gáe Bulg. Only obtainable through her platonic side quest.

-You can now leave Syetren's pub before or after fighting Argarden while you still have access to it in the story. So, you no longer get stuck in there!

That's about it, hopefully you continue to enjoy Euclyca! If you are not sick of Squadron Infra, you can see them again in flashbacks within Exiori, in EA now!

If you would like to continue to support Team Syukino, please consider buying and playing the other games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959050/Exiori/

Also available on Itch.io!
https://syukino.itch.io/exiori

Also check out; Pixel Boy: The Legend of Tain:

https://syukino.itch.io/pixel-boy-the-legend-of-tain

Which the Tain Anima Card is from.

(Coming soon to Steam!)

notes.title: Euclyca v1.2 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/de61136ea757ded66b4f56fc38bc471bfb66596f.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/a58b09d8ab0df7d7c95a0778fb83fed65c63fd05.jpg[/img]
Hello all and welcome to the v1.2 update of Euclyca.

Unfortunately due to financial circumstances, this will
be the game's last update. It has been a pleasure making this game and I appreciate everyone who has
joined me on this long and magical journey.

Without any wait, here is what is new;

1. Added in a new town; Testina. (You can find this town south of Hyluma when you take the boat.

2. A new gather quest with Balls of Yarn can be
found in Testina. You can now find Balls of Yarn
throughout the game. Talk to the npc; Minyetta in Testina to turn them in.

3. Added in an arena mode (you can select at the main menu at the start of a new game). It comes with a spooky mini-game before-hand.

4. Added in a boss fight with Yeleitus. You can find
him in Hellspire Cave.

5. A boss fight featuring Aldren from Falnarion Tactics
will be available to take in Testina. The reward for beating her is a Haku Guardian Crystal. It allows Haku to get a second ultimate weapon for one of his classes.
Please note that if you want a second ultimate dagger for Kein's Spirit Thief Class, you can do so by purchasing and using the Maria Anima Card.

6. Pre-Almadoren Arc characters max level cap has increased from 70 to 80. The Almadoren Arc characters max level cap has increased from 90 to 99. They will start out at level 80 instead of 70 as well. Piggu and Arco's max level cap has been increased from 30 to 40.
Happy grinding~

7. Added in Aldren's Anima Card. (Combat Usage Only).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/01cffafaaa268bd312c57423feff07db32746ee9.png[/img]

8. Added in Zayasu's Anima Card. (Combat Usage Only).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/b4591c57c71d7f1492de666424226ca98cd3024a.png[/img]

9. Added in a few new items including Mercanary Contracts. Purchase and use these to recruit characters to join your party in the arena mode.

Check out other Team Syukino games to see the connections of the story and play Team Syukino's new game; Falnarion Tactics: Oathbreaker (Out now!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562510/Falnarion_Tactics_Oathbreaker/

That is all she wrote. See ya and thanks again for playing Euclyca!

notes.title: Euclyca v1.5 Hotfix!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/4699e5b4f5fe563432785313bb7afe69770a85d6.png[/img]
Here is what is fixed!


-Fixed an issue where you would teleport to Male Ashe's world as Female Ashe.

-For those of you who get trapped in the other Ashe's world by error or by those whose end game is to play both Ashes. I put in an Inter-dimensional Crystal behind a new door in Ashe's room. This allows you to swap Ashes at almost any time during the game. Keep in mind that some story progress doesn't carry over, but key items do so you can get through some content a bit faster if you already did it on one Ashe. Your entire inventory including your items, weapons and armor carry over as well. Ashe's levels and equipped gear do not carry over. Keep in mind that this is experimental.

So yes, whatever level your entire party is when you swap will remain that way. So you can have the possibility to start the new Ashe's journey with a team of overpowered level 70 Guardian Teammates.

notes.title: Euclyca v0.7 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/c646ed535fcecfaa76388a15e43675125aaa169f.jpg[/img]

Hello and welcome to the Euclyca v0.7 Update!
This is the end of the Invasion Arc.

We are now moving into what is called the "Pre-Almadoren" Arc.
This will take place after v0.7, but before v0.8.
During this Arc, things still need to be gathered. Expect an
update soon.

This Arc is not expected to last long in terms of
story as the transition to the Almadoren Arc should happen fast
in the story.

As for the creation of the arc, it may be awhile.
So sit tight and hold on. Thank you so far for your patience.
It's important to note that this game is now 70 percent complete!
Every update is a step closer towards completion!

*No one has found the Easter Event Item yet. Time is ticking!

I decided I shall give a hint; It's in an area that was added in between v0.4.2-0.6 content. So not in a starter area including Crestella Station.

Without any more time being wasted, let us see what is new!


-The story continues! (From where it left off in v0.6).

-Added in the new areas; Path to Pinton, Pinton and Hellspire Cave.

-All enemies are now finished and will be seen throughout the game
either now or later down the road. Please check your Encylopedia tool for detailed information on each enemy as well as information about
skills, items, etc.

-Fixed an issue with the Sacred Seal skill that may or may not
have crashed some people's games.

-Added in Lyla's Flashback Chapter.

-Added in the Almadoren Boss and Battle theme.
You can hear these during boss fights/fights at certain
points in the story. You will be hearing these songs for most of the
rest of the fights when you reach the Almadoren Arc in the future.

-Fixed an issue with the Mine-Field mini-game for Male Ashe that
would accidently bring him to Female Ashe's world.

-The Invaders now give more Kala and Exp when defeated.

-Added in the final tool; Variant Randomizer.
You can find this tool from the npc; Erika in Pinton.
For a modest fee of 50k, you can reroll the dice for a chance
of a better Variant. It's really like the lottery, somewhat.
*May not function properly from continuing from current save.
Best played from a new game or waiting until The Almadoren Arc
transition to use as they will be treated as brand new characters.

-There are now 285 skills in the game. This number is set to
increase during the Almadoren Arc.

-Added in Cherry Gels into the game. A favorite item that is
in some of my other games. Cherry Gels allow you to heal your
party for 40% HP, 40% MP and 40 TP. They are very expensive, but
worth it. You may find them if you look hard enough as well.
They are sold in the Chesire Markets by the npc Lelica. You
must be far enough in the story for this, though.

-All Character Platonic Questlines are finished and are available
at the Guardians Provisional Unit on the left side door with a blue
lion on it.
You can gain access to the Hangout Room if you are far enough in
the story and you have purchased the Hangout Key from the Antique Shop in Idlyn.

-All Side Quests are now impleted into the game and completed.
If you haven't yet, go sink your teeth into them!

-Added in the Momo Anima Card!
Greatly increases all stats within combat for all for
20 turns. Also grants HP, MP and TP Regen in battle.

-Added in some hidden secrets and goodies!

-Potions no longer restore 300HP for one ally. They now restore HP by 22 percent + an additional 219 HP for all allies. These can be summoned by Lyla or found elsewhere.

That is all for now! See you in the later future.

-Syukino.

notes.title: Euclyca Hotfix v1.4!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/f774a901681a696e1e0b4f5f8f1cd7a6dd2b3b5b.png[/img]


Sometimes in life, things work. Sometimes they don't. It's okay to try new things and figure out what does and doesn't in fact... work.

So within this hotfix, let me tell you what I fixed.


-Removed the bright effects as they caused issues of being too damn bright. They would also cause crashes and performance issues. Wasn't worth keeping it in. Game should run smoother now.

-Removed pre-battle transitions as it caused major lag for some computers. As cool as it looked,
it's now a relic of the past. Just like v0.1's Card Quest.

-Removed the Steamworks stuff that was unused and lowered the overall file size a little bit. First time players should see a significant increase to their initial start-up time!

-Removed the WO Build. There is only one "default" build now. Which should work fine for everyone except for the occasional expected bugs that happen during EA.

-Added in the last side-quest that isn't a platonic quest inside of the game. You can find it in the Forgotten Temple, north of Cheshire Pass!

-Also fixed Female Ashe related issues that caused her to end up in Male Ashe's world.

That's all for now!

notes.title: Euclyca v0.5.1 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/c646ed535fcecfaa76388a15e43675125aaa169f.jpg[/img]

Hiya and welcome to another update of Euclyca!
As of now, the easter event is still in play. No one has found it yet! So, good luck to you all!


Without hesitation, let us see what is new!

which doesn't contain the visual effects or any new game changing

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 + Easter Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/21bd7f9bf4b710020ae7897c6521c5dc1938fea5.jpg[/img]

I noticed that I forgot to make the default battle system ATB Active again for new players. So this hotfix is applied to fix that. Also, I added in some extra content to do while you wait for the story to continue in the future. Sgt. Mathers' sprite got finished and replaced. I won't spoil all the secrets I added in.
But, it's probably a good time to explore.

The most notable change;

-Added in a traditional turn-based rpg battle system. You can change to it at the robotic dog in Ashe's room.
You now have the choice of three different battle systems! ATB Active is still the main one that the game is based around, though!

-Players who struggle on their lower end computers with the pre-battle transition screen can now opt into a second beta build called "Low-End". This will remove the transition before the battle. A fair warning, this may cause issues when continuing from a previous save. It's always good to have multiple saves!

-The level cap has increased from 60-70! You won't learn skills after 60 though.

Now for the details of the Easter Event!

All month long until the day after Easter, players will have the opportunity to find a secret invisible prize hidden within the game. I won't give any hints or clues. The only thing I can tell you is that, only the first person who finds it is able to get it. Second place doesn't count! This prize will remain in the game until the time is up or someone has claimed it. If you want to win, play as soon as possible and find it!

notes.title: Euclyca v0.5 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/c646ed535fcecfaa76388a15e43675125aaa169f.jpg[/img]

Hello and welcome to the start of the Invasion Arc!
The game is officially 50 percent done. It has come a long way, but it still has a long way to go. With that being said, every update is another move towards the finish line! Thank you everyone, so far
for your support!

Here is what is new in v0.5;

-The story continues! (Continue the main story from where it left
off in v0.4!)

-You can now change the battle system from ATB active to ATB wait
and vice-versa.
Active: Time flows even when in the Magic or Item menus.
Wait: Time stops while in the Magic or Item menus.
You can change this by interacting with the robotic dog in Ashe's room.

-Added in a Quick-Save tool called the Guardian's Journal. This is a short-cut to the Save Menu basically. It will allow people to save with a push of a button. Or you can just manually save through the Camp Menu as usual. This item will be given to you automatically at the start of a new game or it will be given to you automatically at any of the four locations; Euclyca (Central), Yuntino Station, Setsuno Station and Crestella Station.

-Ashe's Dad now gives you more Kala, Items and a Bust-A-Nut at the
start of a new game. For those of you who struggle with the Kappa
bosses, just throw that item at one of them to help even the playing
field. Bust-A-Nut's are a super rare item that do about 2-3k damage
a hit to one target. Make sure to summon Piggu or Arco to help you as well!

-Added in the Holy Cross tool. Use it to roll the dice for blessings
and to get rid of curses. All are 1000 Kala each. You can obtain this tool by speaking to Sister Dry Vadge inside the Euclyca Church. Unlockable after the Guardian Trials.

-All elemental birds are already in the game and grant some attributes
and a special skill unique to them to the entire party. Find all
four of them!

-Added in a few more items to craft within the Creation Device!
(The Item-Crafting tool).

-Added in more base weapons and accessories in the Item Bell tool. As well as fixed the error of the Armor section allowing you to sell stuff.
 (You shouldn't be able to).

-Added in Hyluma, Cheshire Pass, Cheshire Market, Dusty Stop, Oblunga Mines, Setsuno City and the Setsuno Sea locations.

-Added in a few more side quests.

-Changed the amount of Spirit Thief Kein's Limit Break; Great Fortune.
From 1000 Kala per use to 3000 Kala per use. Also now adds a buff
to double items/money.

-EXP tickets have changed from 1000 Kala to 2000 Kala in store price.
They are worth more sold now and can be obtained by Kein's Golden
Goose ability during combat. (The skill is for any of Kein's Classes).
EXP tickets now give 400 EXP to the entire party when consumed
instead of 100 EXP.

-Lowered the Defense and HP of the White Fang boss in Mina's
Sensual Questline. 20000HP to 15000HP. 94 Defense to 80 Defense.

-The Skill; Heavy Strike, has been buffed!

-The Skill; Armor Piercer, now has the ability to lower defense for
three turns!

-Added in the Beast Trainer tool. It allows you to fight one of five different mobs at any given time.

-Added in the item; Big Beef Sammich!

-Added in a bunch of secret bosses!

It's important to note that during any RPG game. If your party runs out of HP. You get a game over. So, if you only have one party member in the party and they are dead. Well, you get a game over. So, make sure to keep those bastards alive! If they are dead by the end of any fight. They will not get any EXP. Gaining EXP allows for a level up which in turn fully heals your party member. Always revive those who are dead whatever chance you get. Thank you listening to my Ted talk!


Anyways, the fix is as follows;

Added in an automatic full heal before and after every Guardian Trial member swap and before and after the Guardian Trials take place themselves.



Thank you for your interest in Euclyca and I look forward to your suggestions and fixing the annoying bugs you point out ♥~

notes.title: Euclyca v0.4 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662616/c646ed535fcecfaa76388a15e43675125aaa169f.jpg[/img]
Welcome to Euclyca v0.4!

I know it hasn't been long since v0.3 has been released. But I was able to pump this one out quick
because the tasks required for this one wasn't as demanding. (v0.5 will be a new arc and will take
longer).

Anyways, let us see what is new;


-Added in more of the story. (This is the end of the Guardian's Arc.
v0.5 will begin the Invasion Arc).

-Added in around 15 more skills. (Several for Dragon Monk Haku and Onna-Bugeisha Mina).

-Edited/Enhanced some skill animations to make them a bit more exciting.

-Changed the number style for the battle combo counter hit number.

-Added in a Battle, Menu and Normal cursor for a more interactive interface for mouse users.

-Some skills now have a delayed death effect upon use. If you manage to bring an enemy with
a skill that delays death down to 0HP. The enemy with 0HP will be allowed to have one
final move to execute before they perish. They will die immediately after their turn.
Use and figure out which moves contain this ability and then strategize accordingly.

-Halcyone (Kickstarter backer's character) is now a playable character and she joins the party
briefly in this update for the story.

-A NSFW scene between Ashe and Mina is available in Mina's Flashback in this update.

-More of Euclyca is now unlocked and explorable. The Warehouse, Restoration District and The Casino
are now available to walk around in. The Arena mini-game is now unlocked within the Casino.
Unlike Arena mode in previous Team Syukino games. This is a very short mini-game with only one rank.

-The Jukebox is now available in the Casino. Listen to a few tunes from Euclyca or previous TS games.

*Please keep in mind that some areas of the world of Normellia are only accessible via the story or character quests. Like the pub closed by Torvid-18 or Cafe Depresso.

-Added in the final and unique collectable Anima Cards.

-Replaced Maria's face picture with a much higher resolution version.

-A new tool for the toolbar is available. It's location is a secret. Talk to Halcyone for a tip!

-A few under the hood changes and fixes.

-Some more grammar fixes as well!

It's important to know that... v0.2 came out quick when v0.1 did. But between v0.2 and v0.2.9...
there was a huge gap. This is because it was a new arc being introduced and a lot of work had
to be done that the v0.3 was split into two. v0.4 does arrive quickly, but with v0.5 being a new
arc. It's important to not expect it so quickly. It's going to need more than the quicker updates.
But, hopefully it will be quicker than v0.2.9. Anyways, I appreciate your patience and I look
forward to bringing this game to completion. Please look forward to Euclyca's early access release
on Steam on February 22nd, 2021!
